notes.title: [230826] 1st Anniversary Greeting
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42096399/2ec202e481df6716a7257b2758144e9279e42c78.png[/img]

On August 26, 2022, I officially released 'Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2 (MGMA2)', and today, I have reached the first anniversary since that release. I sincerely appreciate the many individuals who have played and supported us. I offer my heartfelt gratitude.

From the moment of the official release, and even during the early access stages, your feedback and support have allowed me to shape new ideas and evolve the world of 'MGMA' I will continue to strive with passion to create a more captivating and serene atmosphere in the world.

Lastly, the warm words of encouragement from all of you serve as my strength. Throughout the development process, there were numerous obstacles that were overcome thanks to your support. Many ideas that would have been difficult to bring to life alone were realized through your advice and assistance. The ability to craft a tranquil atmosphere within the world is a testament to the kind and watchful presence of all who have supported me. If there are any sequels or new developments for 'MGMA' in the future, I kindly ask for your continued support.


Nekotokage Games. Nekotokage.(ねことかげ)


(※ This is using machine translation. Sorry if it was not clear to you.)

notes.title: [230813] Notification
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2." We sincerely appreciate your continued support since the release of the 1.0 update on August 26, 2022. It's hard to believe that a year has already passed since then. We want to take this opportunity to express our gratitude once again for the many encouragements we've received during this time.

Now, on the occasion of reaching the one-year milestone since the 1.0 update, we are excited to announce a collaboration with the indie game studio "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=ZephyrStudio]ZephyrStudio[/url]"'s "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660290/_/]Mon Musu Gladiator[/url]※". This collaboration will bring together the worlds of "Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure" and "Mon Musu Gladiator," allowing "Monster Girls" to shine across both works, transcending the boundaries of their respective stories.

Furthermore, we will be addressing several issues, enhancing features, and adding some small-scale events. Although it is a modest "mini-update," we are planning to release it on August 24, ahead of our first anniversary. We hope you look forward to this collaboration project in conjunction with the upcoming anniversary.


※ "Mon Musu Gladiator" is a deck-building roguelite RPG where you nurture, battle, and aim for supremacy with various monster girls. The developers at "ZephyrStudio" have plans for collaborations with various works, including "Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure," so be sure to check it out.

notes.title: ［221008］ver1.1 Update Info
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing " Monster Girls and Mysterious Adventure 2".
 Today, October 8, we have released the ver 1.1 update.
 Although this is a small 1.1 update compared to the 1.0 update at the end of Early Access, please take a moment to review the additions and changes.


[h2]ver 1.1 Update Contents[/h2]

[h3]Event[/h3]
・Replaced some of the story events.
・Added several events not related to the storyline.

[h3]Dungeon[/h3]
・Add several dungeons.
・Add traps.
・Add new Sensei.
・Add dungeon gimmick.
・Fixed bug that caused meal effects to fluctuate on retry.
・Fixed the level of some characters.

[h3]Base and Facility[/h3]
・Add Facility.
・Add Furniture.
・Add home extensions.
・Fixed bug where characters appeared in inaccessible areas

[h3]Character[/h3]
・Add animations.
・Fixed animation of some monsters.
・Fixed bug that caused some gifts to move position when given.

[h3]Items[/h3]
・Add items.
・Add a function to gain TP when throwing magic balls.

[h3]Item Title[/h3]
・Add Item Title.

[h3]Skills[/h3]
・Add Skills.
・Fixed bug where text and effect of some skills did not match.

[h3]System[/h3]
・Removed and added achievements.
・Fixed some UI.
・Fixed behavior of some abnormalities.
・Fixed a bug in the change of Like level by some attacks.


[h3]Additional dungeon events[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42096399/375cb9b780d3e70c1e932d5daef6045d719bf94d.png[/img]
After certain events, you go to the village well...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42096399/015b79daa461678670e70e79644f0505d8e1cd52.png[/img]
After certain events, you enter the workshop...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42096399/4d17db9b8ad2f35d6c1fd8b9d12ba7b86e127b92.png[/img]
After accomplishing Tamamo's request, go to the far end of the forest...




[h2]Development after ver 1.1 update[/h2]
　As we announced in our recent news release, we have completed most of the contents that we had planned at the beginning of the development, and therefore, we consider this Ver. 1.1 update to be the final version, and have finished the development for the purpose of expanding and adding major functions. (Development to fix bugs and improve the playing experience will continue.)
　I will concentrate on fixing the bugs, completing the remaining projects, and then improving my own programming abilities. In the process, I may be able to provide small updates other than bug fixes. I would appreciate your continued support.




Please note
　Due to the large number of contacts we have received, it is difficult for us to respond to each individual contact, especially on social networking sites.

Thank you for playing " Monster Girl and the Mysterious Adventure 2".

notes.title: ［220826］ver1.0 Update Info
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing the Early Access version of "Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2".
After the Early Access version was released on April 9 and the 0.2 Middle Update was released on June 24, the ver 1.0 update was released today, August 26.

　Based on your cooperation, we have made various additions and corrections. Please check the following information.



[h2]ver 1.0 update distribution details[/h2]

[h3]Events[/h3]
・Addition of storylines


[h3]Dungeon[/h3]
・Addition of dungeons
・Early Access dungeons have been removed.
(Characters will be assigned to different dungeons and achievements will not be affected.)
・Addition of special tiles
・Addition of special floor effects
・Addition of stone statues
・Addition of traps
・Adjusted the effect of wooden arrow traps.
・Addition of new Sensei


[h3]Bases and Facilities[/h3]
・Addition of facilities
・Addition of furniture
・Raising the level of home function expansion
・Addition of meal (added in stages according to the number of meals)
・Add a take-home function for cat food.


[h3]Monster[/h3]
・Addition of special Monster
・Addition of animations
・Fixed animations of some Monster.
・Fixed the face icons of some Monster.
・Fixed the conditions for some Monsters to become friends with other Monster.


[h3]Items[/h3]
・Addition of items
・Changed the method of drawing lots for ornaments.
・Changed the method of drawing lots for beads of magical power
・Added an effect when damaged food is consumed.
・Modified the method of changing the friendship or intimacy level by gifts.


[h3]Titles[/h3]
・Addition of titles
・Changed the method of drawing lots for titles.
・Modified the effect of some titles on the amount of money spent.


[h3]Skills[/h3] 
・Addition of skills
・Changed the names of some skills.
・Changed so that the effects of some skills are duplicated.
・Modified the use MP or SP of some skills.
・Modified the effects of some recovery skills.


[h3]System[/h3]
・Changed the maximum value of MP to 100
・Expanded the functionality of the Monster Pictorial Book.
・Changed to refer to the funds in the warehouse when making purchases in the base.
・When you try to dive again after a failed dive, you can eat Meal again.
・Added a random naming function when naming a companion demon.
・Added a predictive conversion function when naming unidentified items.
・Modified the method of calculating the experience value.
 



[h2]Future of "Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2"[/h2]

 We have ended the Early Access since the game has reached the stage where the story can be played to completion, but we will continue to implement features that took a long time to verify, fix bugs, and improve the playing experience.
(Some features will be available for the first time after the Early Access phase ends, and we expect to deliver frequent updates to fix them.)

In parallel with the fixes, we are also planning to release a "full version" of the game with the following additions
・Additional dungeons
・Additional characters
・Additional items
・Additional titles
・Additional skills
・Addition of housing (furniture, buildings)
・Character animations in the base, etc.
　

 After these tasks are completed, we are planning to implement some elements that can develop the story and some extra features once we have a living environment that allows us to focus on development due to sales.
We will also consider whether or not to support languages other than Japanese and English, which we have received a lot of feedback on, after taking into consideration the cost of translation and sales.

 We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the translation work for the time being. We will continue to work hard to improve the product, and we hope you will continue to support us.




　We will continue to work on resolving bugs and glitches. Please contact us by using the dedicated form on our website.

notes.title: [220820]Early Access Edition Launch News
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing the Early Access version of "Monster Girl and the Mysterious Adventure 2".
We have received a lot of feedback on the 0.2 medium update that was released on June 24, and we have almost finished fixing the major problems that were identified. Thank you very much for your cooperation.

　Since the Early Access version was released on April 9, we have received many suggestions of problems, including bugs, and we have been able to continue development day after day despite the inconvenience caused by your support.
　We are pleased to announce that we have decided to release the 1.0 commercial version update, although it will be a month later than we had originally expected.


[h2]Contents of the 1.0 Product Version update (Planned)[/h2] 

[h3]●Date of release[/h3]
August 26th, Friday 

[h3]●Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Story
[*] Dungeons
[*] Characters
[*] Items
[*] Item titles
[*] Skills
[*] Commands and Gimmicks

notes.title: [Ver 0.2.06240] Update Info
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing the Early Access version of "Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2".
It’s released on April 9, and the 0.2 mid-size update was finally completed. I would like to say thank you to everyone who has been waiting for it and supporting me.

 The 0.2 mid-size update included twice as many characters, dungeons, housing, etc. as before, however more features must be expected in the "Early Access" version.
You may notice some rough edges for a while, but I hope you will continue to enjoy the game and appreciate your cooperation to make it even better.


 The game version will be 0.2.0624 once you install the 0.2 medium update, and revised points will be reflected. Please take a look at the following information for details.

[h2]Additional Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Additional stories and events.
[*] Additional dungeons. (Some dungeons are available only in the EA version.)
[*] Addition of characters. (Some characters cannot be added to your friends in the EA version.)
[*] Additional items.
[*] Additional item titles.
[*] Additional skills.
[*] Additional functions and gimmicks.
[*] Additional housing options. (furniturea or buildings)
[/list]

[h2]Changed or modified items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Change in damage calculation(Basic Attack and Skill Attacks).
[*] Modified the method of calculating acquired experience
[*] Change in the status and growth rate of all characters
[*] Change in the rate of increase in status when strengthening the Friends (It’s applied when you strengthen Friends)
[*] Modifying SP amount and its usage rate when Friends use a skill
[*] Modifying TP amount and the upper limit when Friends learn skills (It’s applied when you strengthen Friends)
[*] Expanding conditions for accepting skill requests
[*] Modifying MP amount and effects of the main character's skills
[*] Changes in the  specifications of the title which damage depends on conditions.
[*] Change in the mark as below
[*] MP is consumed when activating the "風(wind)" mark.
[*] MP is consumed when activating the "魔(magic)" mark.
[*] SP consumption was modified when the "重(heavy)" mark is applied.
[*] Damage calculation was modified when each  “Spear” mark is applied.
[*] Damage calculation for the "Gold" mark was modified. 
[*] Damage calculation for various "Suicide" marks was modified.
[*] Damage calculation for "Gold" mark was modified. 
[*] Recovery calculation for "Recovery" mark was modified.
[*] Change in the amount of status increase by magic balls.
[/list]

There are many additional or revised items, and you may feel uncomfortable with some of them.
I apologize for your inconvenience due to the basic change in contents of training.
I will do my best to refrain from large-scale revision after this update, but there is a possibility that I may need to do so as I receive feedback. 
I’d very much appreciate it if you kindly understand the purpose of Early Access.
It’s best to create backup data when you update the version.


[h2]Future development[/h2]
If there isn't much trouble and I can go on to develop the game as expected,  the full version will be released in two months, in August at the latest. (Please note that the schedule could be delayed because this is a personal development game and there is no one who can be replaced.)
I’ll take care of myself and continue to develop it to release the full version as soon as possible.

[h2]To those who play this game for the first time[/h2]
This is an Early Access version (unfinished version). Even though the 0.2 medium update was released, the volume of the game is only half of the finished version.
There is also a possibility that the game may have glitches which prevent you from progressing, or that the balance of the game may change significantly due to changes or modifications to the content.
Please kindly understand it and make sure that the game works properly when you play the trial version before purchasing.

notes.title: [220424]Early Access Edition Launch News
notes.notes:
It has been two weeks since I launched Early Access on April 9.
I have received more than 1,000 messages of support, opinions, and sharing of bugs.
I appreciate your daily feedback and motivation for further developments.
I apologize that I have not been able to respond individually due to time restraints, but I have read all of your emails and Steam threads. Thank you very much.

While I am currently working on the developments of the final version of the game and fixing the bugs, I am pleased to announce that additional elements are supposed to be implemented soon, that will be included in the final version.
I am planning a mid-size update including storyline, multiple dungeons, new monsters nwe skills and items.
It may take a month, or even two months, to complete the mid-size update, but I hope you will be excited about it.

My responses to comments and developments are as below.


[b]I want to relocate the facilities in the base.[/b]
You will be able to relocate the facilities that have already been built in the full version. Due to the story line, this function is not available in the Early Access version. Please wait for a while.

[b]I want to delete the marks on bracelets and ornaments.[/b]
A new facility will be added to delete marks as the story progresses. This function is not available at this time.

[b]I want to have the function to register and sort my favorite friends and to reorder them during adventures.[/b]
I apologize, but it would take tens of hours to review, reflect, and verify the program, so I am not able to launch it immediately. I will work on this while developing new content.

[b]Please increase the storage capacity in the warehouse.[/b]
I plan to gradually increase the warehouse capacity as the story progresses. In past version updates, I expanded it ahead of schedule, but the saved data became too large, causing delays in development and verification. Please wait for further warehouse expansion as it could affect future updates. I apologize for your inconvenience.

[b]Please review the magic balls that increase the status.[/b]
In the version after Early Access, the status will be increased more by the magic balls. I will review the status rise rate including the current ones.

[b]Please review the balance of the game.[/b]
As you get to higher Lv, the game tempo is significantly slowing down due to lengthy battles caused by high HP and low damage. I have also received feedback that HP increases to the point where fixed damage becomes meaningless, such as when using dragon fire.
Therefore, I am planning to improve and adjust the following points in the above mentioned mid-size update.
[list]
[*] Review all character statuses.
[*] Review acquired experience values. (some experience values were multiplied when they should have been added)
[*] Review how much character status increases when doing Melt’s Enhancement (status will be increased more after the update).
[/list]

Even though this is an Early Access version, I sincerely apologize for changing the status values of the characters you have spent so much time and effort to raise.
If you are not satisfied with the future changes, you can keep your friends as they are now (the changes will not be effective if you do not Melt’s Enhancement).

I will do our best to refrain from making any further changes, but please note that the current balance will not allow you to fully enjoy the dungeons and characters that will be added in the future, and that I may need to make further adjustments depending on other requests.

These are some of the most common requests I have received.
I will continue to work on the minor issues that are not listed here as well. 

Lastly, please note that I have received a lot of inquiries, and it is difficult for me to respond to each one individually (I have read all of them).
In case of any inconvenience, please contact me by filling out the form on my website.

HP : https://forms.gle/Jroount8m1rcEaLs8


Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Early Access Edition Launch News
notes.notes:
※Machine Translation.

Thanks to your support, we are pleased to announce that the Early Access version of the game is available today, April 9.

In this version, you will be able to enjoy two story-related dungeons and one additional dungeon that is exclusive to the Early Access version.

As of this writing, we are still working on the final version of the game, so please continue to support us.


Below are answers to some of the questions we have received.


I want to know if I can play the game in my environment.
A free trial version is available on the developer's website. We recommend that you try it before purchasing.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10Hf4cdV3fpDdXnKUZbSUftKS49wcYMVD


What is the Early Access version?
This is an incomplete version of the game, with adjustments to the game content and balance, and possible glitches such as progression being stopped.
If you are willing to accept these changes and glitches, please play the game and give us your feedback.
We will try to improve the game by incorporating your feedback.

To contact us, please visit the developer's website
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc7reH1ka6jVWInzTDvL8Cskoh0Jh_VGe93vcwj-DwJAZwfzA/viewform

If you expect a certain level of quality, you may want to wait to purchase the game until the bugs and game balance have been improved (until the end of Early Access).


What are the plans after Early Access?
We plan to move to the final version in about three months. At that time, we promise to increase the volume by more than double the Early Access version.
We will post information about urgent development goals and bug fixes on the developer's website and social networking sites as they become available.


●Are there any plans to distribute the game outside of the PC?
We cannot make any promises at this stage, but we are willing to release on PS4 and Nintendo Switch.
We are aiming to develop a completed version first, and then we will consider developing the game.


Will there be support for languages other than Japanese and English?
Due to the large amount of text (approximately 500,000 characters at the time of Early Access) and the difficulty in raising translation costs, there are no plans at this time to support multiple languages.
There is a way to use crowdfunding and other support mechanisms, but for now we will focus on development.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)
